atributos.Name: Strength
atributos.Description: Determines output capacity for melee classes, current output capacity is {rate}.

atributos.Name: Intelligence
atributos.Description: Determines output capacity for caster classes, current output capacity is {rate}.

atributos.Name: Agility
atributos.Description: Determines battle turn progress speed. When Hit Rate Adjustment and Dodge Rate Adjustment are presented, agility can increase hit/dodge rate as well. Current hit rating is {hitrating} and dodge rating is {dodgerating}. (Both can be increased by relevant adjustment rates).

atributos.Name: Critical Hit Rate
atributos.Description: Determines the chance of dealing critical damage or heal.

atributos.Name: Vitality
atributos.Description: Determines max health points, current max health points is {rate}.

atributos.Name: Critical Damage
atributos.Description: Determines critical hit damage/heal.

atributos.Name: Physical Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against physical damage. Reduces {rate}% physical damage done by lv. {level} enemies (reduction rate is increased for lower level enemies, and is decreased for higher level enemies).

atributos.Name: Fire Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against fire damage. Reduces {rate}% fire damage done by lv. {level} enemies (reduction rate is increased for lower level enemies, and is decreased for higher level enemies).

atributos.Name: Shadow Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against shadow damage. Reduces {rate}% shadow damage done by lv. {level} enemies (reduction rate is increased for lower level enemies, and is decreased for higher level enemies).

atributos.Name: Ice Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against ice damage. Reduces {rate}% ice damage done by lv. {level} enemies (reduction rate is increased for lower level enemies, and is decreased for higher level enemies).

atributos.Name: Poison Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against poison damage. Reduces {rate}% poison damage done by lv. {level} enemies (reduction rate is increased for lower level enemies, and is decreased for higher level enemies).

atributos.Name: Divine Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against divine damage. Reduces {rate}% divine damage done by lv. {level} enemies (reduction rate is increased for lower level enemies, and is decreased for higher level enemies).

atributos.Name: Lightning Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against lightning damage. Reduces {rate}% lightning damage done by lv. {level} enemies (reduction rate is increased for lower level enemies, and is decreased for higher level enemies).

atributos.Name: All Elemental Resistance
atributos.Description: Defense against all elemental damage, check individual elemental resistance for details

atributos.Name: Life on Hit
atributos.Description: Rate of heal per damage dealt, up to 20% of wearer's total health points.

atributos.Name: Taunt on Hit
atributos.Description: Chance of taunting target per hit for 3 seconds

atributos.Name: Stun on Hit
atributos.Description: Chance of stunning target for 2 seconds on hit

atributos.Name: Damage Reflection
atributos.Description: Percentage of damage to be reflected back to attacker. Damage values used for reflection calculation are raw damage (no resistance reductions), and reflected damage is of type Real Damage.

atributos.Name: Battle Recovery
atributos.Description: Heal rate at the start of each battle.

atributos.Name: Turn Recovery
atributos.Description: Heal rate each turn.

atributos.Name: Mining Mastery
atributos.Description: Increases the amount of ores dropped from enemies.

atributos.Name: Logging Mastery
atributos.Description: Increases the amount of timbers dropped from enemies.

atributos.Name: Hunting Mastery
atributos.Description: Increases the amount of hides dropped from enemies.

atributos.Name: Heal Effectivenesss
atributos.Description: Increases heal received.

atributos.Name: Fire Damage Enhancement
atributos.Description: Increases fire damage done from all sources: skills, tactics, items, effects, etc.

atributos.Name: Physical Damage Enhancement
atributos.Description: Increases physical damage done from all sources: skills, tactics, items, effects, etc.

atributos.Name: Resilience
atributos.Description: Decreases critical damage received

atributos.Name: Damage Reduction
atributos.Description: Further reduces all damage taken after resistance calculations

atributos.Name: Ice Damage Enhancement
atributos.Description: Increases ice damage done from all sources: skills, tactics, items, effects, etc.

atributos.Name: Shadow Damage Enhancement
atributos.Description: Increases shadow damage done from all sources: skills, tactics, items, effects, etc.

atributos.Name: Poison Damage Enhancement
atributos.Description: Increases poison damage done from all sources: skills, tactics, items, effects, etc.

atributos.Name: Divine Damage Enhancement
atributos.Description: Increases divine damage done from all sources: skills, tactics, items, effects, etc.

atributos.Name: Lightning Damage Enhancement
atributos.Description: Increases lightning damage done from all sources: skills, tactics, items, effects, etc.

atributos.Name: Rage Efficiency
atributos.Description: Decreases tactic rage cost, up to 80%.

atributos.Name: Heal Absorption
atributos.Description: The portion of direct heal gets converted into damage absorption shield, up to adventurer's maximum health points.

atributos.Name: Effect Mastery
atributos.Description: Increases lasting time of all positive and negative effects from skills, tactic and items.

atributos.Name: Hit Rate Adjustment
atributos.Description: Increases percentage of agility participating in Hit Rate Calculation for enemies that can dodge. Higher values grant higher hit rate.

atributos.Name: Dodge Rate Adjustment
atributos.Description: Enables dodge and increases percentage of agility participating in Hit Rate Calculation. Higher values grant higher dodge rate.

atributos.Name: Effect Hit Rating
atributos.Description: Reduces enemies' chance of resisting caster's negative effects. Useful on higher level enemies (lv.80+).

atributos.Name: Effect Resistance Rating
atributos.Description: Increases chances of resisting negative effects.

atributos.Name: Phyical Penetration
atributos.Description: Percentage of Physical Resistance to be ignored when dealing damage

atributos.Name: Fire Penetration
atributos.Description: Percentage of Fire Resistance to be ignored when dealing damage

atributos.Name: Ice penetration
atributos.Description: Percentage of Ice Resistance to be ignored when dealing damage

atributos.Name: Shadow Penetration
atributos.Description: Percentage of Shadow Resistance to be ignored when dealing damage

atributos.Name: Poison Penetration
atributos.Description: Percentage of Shadow Resistance to be ignored when dealing damage

atributos.Name: Divine Penetration
atributos.Description: Percentage of Divine Resistance to be ignored when dealing damage

atributos.Name: Lightning Penetration
atributos.Description: Percentage of Lightning Resistance to be ignored when dealing damage

ressalva_propriedades: Quantidade base adicional; Crystal Stone, eventos, efeitos Star e garantias do template modificam o resultado.
